description: The concentration channel the auto-selector chose for a well, as a single row. Falls back to 'auger' when the well has no pick or no row at all. Dashboards call this on well change to pre-select the dropdown.
sql: SELECT COALESCE((SELECT wc.concentration_feature FROM featurestore:nextier_well_conc_channel_v1 wc WHERE wc.well_name = :well_name), 'auger') AS concentration_feature
